title: अपने ढंग से कहिए
caption: वेपॉइंट सोलह भाषाएँ बोलता है। मीरा उनमें से छह में नमस्ते कहती है।
linkedin_text:
Most people think in a language other than the one their apps speak.

Waypoint works in 16 languages, shows its own words in the one you pick, and can translate a post with one tap. Mira says hello in six of them; every screen is the real app in that language.

scenes.clip: Mira, a young woman with long dark hair in a lilac hoodie, facing the camera on a bright rooftop with a view of a city at golden hour, smiling warmly.
scenes.vo: नमस्ते, मैं मीरा हूँ। वेपॉइंट सोलह भाषाएँ बोलता है। सुनिए।
